term.label: TRIM

definition.text: TRIM elements have terminal direct repeat sequences of 100-250 bp in length that flank an internal domain of 100–300 bp. TRIMs lack coding domains and thus do not encode proteins.

comments: Added as per GitHub Issue Request #429 (https://github.com/The-Sequence-Ontology/SO-Ontologies/issues/429)
